topic: 资源分配与阶段检查 · Independent new scenario: a team challenging a conclusion from incomplete data
grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The Missing Survey: A Team Challenges a Conclusion
instructions: 这是一份原创的模拟英语听力与语法练习，适合B1–B2水平的成人学习者。请先听或读对话，然后完成10道听力理解题。之后学习条件句、数量词和段落衔接的新规则，并完成8道语法题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。注意：对话中的人物会自然修正和插话，答案不会直接读出。请仔细根据原文作答。
transcript:
Maya: Okay, everyone, thanks for coming. I want to talk about the new lunch menu. We sent a survey to 40 people last week, and 32 said they liked the menu. That's 80 percent. So I think we can say the menu is a big success.

Ben: Wait, Maya. You said 40 people got the survey, but how many actually answered?

Maya: Well, 32 people answered. That's the 80 percent.

Ben: Right, but that means only 32 out of 40 responded. And how many people work in this building?

Maya: About 200.

Ben: So we only heard from 32 out of 200. That's 16 percent. We can't say the menu is a success for everyone. If we want a real answer, we need more people to respond.

Maya: Hmm, I see your point. But the 32 people who answered were very positive. Almost all of them said they liked it.

Ben: Yes, but maybe the people who didn't like it didn't answer. That's a problem. If only happy people answer, the result is not fair.

Maya: Okay, that's a good point. So what should we do?

Ben: Let's send the survey again, but this time to all 200 people. And we can offer a small coffee coupon to people who finish it. If we get at least 100 answers, the result will be more reliable.

Maya: That sounds good. But we need to check the results at the end of the month, not just at the end. We should do a stage check every week.

Ben: Agreed. So, first, we send the survey to everyone. Second, we check how many people answer each week. Third, if we have enough answers, we look at the results together.

Maya: Perfect. And let's also ask one question about the price. Some people said the lunch is too expensive. If we don't ask about price, we might miss an important issue.

Ben: Good idea. So the new survey will have three parts: taste, price, and variety. And we will compare the answers from different groups, like people who eat lunch here every day and people who bring lunch from home.

Maya: Yes, that's better. So we are not saying the menu is a success yet. We are saying we need more data before we decide.

Ben: Exactly. And if the new results are different from the old ones, we will learn something important. That's the whole point of checking.

Maya: Thanks, Ben. I'm glad we talked. Let's start the new survey on Monday.

grammar.title: 条件句、数量词与段落衔接
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 条件句：用 if 引导条件，主句用 will 或情态动词表示结果。例如：If we get more answers, the result will be reliable. 2) 数量词：表示数量的词如 all, some, most, none, 以及具体数字。注意区分整体和部分。例如：32 out of 200 表示部分。3) 段落间的指代与衔接：用 this, that, these, those, it, they 等指代前文内容，使段落连贯。例如：That's a problem. 中的 That 指代前一句的情况。新规则：条件句中 if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。
grammar.example: If we get at least 100 answers, the result will be more reliable.

questions.prompt: If we ______ more people, the survey will be better.
questions.explanation: 条件句中 if 从句用一般现在时，所以选 ask。
questions.evidence: If we get at least 100 answers, the result will be more reliable.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ______ the event.
questions.explanation: 主句表示将来结果，用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: If we get at least 100 answers, the result will be more reliable.

questions.prompt: ______ of the 200 employees answered the first survey.
questions.explanation: 表示“只有32人”用 Only 32 of the 200 employees。
questions.evidence: So we only heard from 32 out of 200.

questions.prompt: Most people liked the menu, but ______ people did not answer.
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表示“一些”用 some。
questions.evidence: Some people said the lunch is too expensive.

questions.prompt: We need more data. ______ is why we will send a new survey.
questions.explanation: 用 That 指代前一句“我们需要更多数据”这一情况。
questions.evidence: That's the whole point of checking.

questions.prompt: The first survey had 32 answers. ______ answers were mostly positive.
questions.explanation: 指代复数名词 answers，用 These。
questions.evidence: the 32 people who answered were very positive

questions.prompt: If we ______ enough answers, we will look at the results together.
questions.explanation: if 从句用一般现在时 have。
questions.evidence: if we have enough answers, we look at the results together.

questions.prompt: ______ the people who answered, almost all liked the menu.
questions.explanation: 表示“在……之中”用 Of the people who answered。
questions.evidence: Almost all of them said they liked it.
